title: Sitting judge scores
description: One JSON array. One object per scenario run, in scenario-file order. error is present only when that run failed.

run_id.description: First 16 hex chars of SHA-256 over rubric_sha256, newline, scenario id, newline, runner.

runner.description: The --runner command template as given, with {scenario} unexpanded.

rubric_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the line 'dimensions: ' + the front-matter dimensions joined by commas + newline, followed by the normalised rubric body. version and the rest of the front matter are not hashed.
